page.layout: One column of running text, full width; page number at top right; running head at top centre. Scripted lexicon entries with Hebrew, Syriac and Chaldaic words in their own letters, Latin glosses and biblical references. No marginal notes.

main_text.p: plenitudinem horæ: Tremellius reddit, Minutum horæ, ad Gal.2.5.
מְלִיתָא, מְלֵאתָא, מְלִיתָא מְלִיָא Ch. Repletio, plenitudo: Item Obstructio, vallum, agger: Plur. מְלִיתָא, Jerem.32.24.
ܡܠܝܢܐ, ܡܠܝܢܐ Syr. Plenitudo, impletio, adimpletio, complementum, supplementum.
מוליתא Ch. Mula, Exo.14.7. Jon. Pl. מוליתא Ibid.v.25.
ܡܠܦܢ Syr. Loquutio, Hinc, ܡܠܦܢ Loquutio in cor, Consolatio, ad Philip.2.1.
ܡܠܓ ܡܠܝ Syriac. Vellere, evellere, avellere, Marc.2.23.
מְלָח מִלְחָא Chald. ܡܠܚ Syr. Sal: ܩܡܐ ܕܡܠܚܐ Statua salis, Gen.19.26.
מְלַח Ch. Salire, sale condire: Item Vastare, juxta quosdam, Esræ 4.14. Ithpehal אִתְמְלַח Ch. & Syr. Saliri, sale condiri.
ܡܠܚܐ Syr. Salsum. Plur. ܡܠܚܝܢ ܡܠܝܢ Aquæ salsæ, Jac.3.12.
מַלְחָא Chald. & Syr. Nauta, Nauclerus, Prov.23.34. Plur.emph. מַלָּחַיָּא Psal.107.23. Syr. ܡܠܚܝܢ, Act. 27.27.30.
מְלוּחַ Ch. Urtica. Plur. מְלוּחִין Soph.2.9.

page.notes: Hebrew, Syriac and Chaldaic words are transcribed from the scan as well as legible; vowel points and diacritics are approximate. The final word "מלט" stands alone at the lower right, perhaps a catchword or part of a signature.
